final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), metrics AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS share_of_town_transactions, 1.0 * transaction_count / AVG(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS ratio_to_town_average FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, share_of_town_transactions, ratio_to_town_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_town_average DESC LIMIT 10
